test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.**

Stray
solution:
The correct answer is: **Homeless**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Stray **means lost or having no home.

 
 
• Example -* The dog was a **stray **which had been adopted.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Homeless **means having no home or permanent place of residence.
 
 
• Example -* My heart ached for the starving **homeless **children. *
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Stray**' and '**Homeless**' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Casual **means relaxed and not worried; without showing great effort or interest.
 
• **Careless **means resulting from a lack of thought or attention to detail.
 
• **Fickle **means always changing your mind or your feelings so you cannot be trusted.
